payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over all pairs (i,j) of flamingos, computes line equation, and counts collinear flamingos for each valid integer binocular x-coordinate.
payload.rationale: The solution is a brute-force complete search with triple nested loops, not using any graph traversal or DFS/BFS. The candidate subtype is chosen because it is the highest-scored, though it does not match the solution's mechanism.
